title: The Forbidden Contract
summary: Ha-Jun accepts the forbidden Demon Sovereign Contract despite its dire warnings about memory loss and eternal pursuit. As his blood seals the pact, his classmate Min-Jae arrives on the devastated rooftop, witnessing the first signs that Ha-Jun is no longer human.

panels.action: The obsidian holographic contract screen hovers in the rain, purple text glowing with ominous ancient warnings.
Ha-Jun's index finger hovers inches away from the glowing purple [ACCEPT] prompt, raindrops dripping from his knuckle.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ek baar click kiya... toh koi wapsi nahi hogi.

panels.action: Kuro perches on Ha-Jun's shoulder, speaking in low grave tones: 'Shartein dhyan se padh lo, boy. Taqat kabhi muft nahi milti.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se padho. Sovereign ka takht qurbaniyon se banta hai.

panels.action: The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 1: INSAANI KAMZORI DHEERE DHEERE MIT JAAYEGI].
The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 2: ABYSS KE MONSTERS AUR DEMON HUNTERS TUMHARA PEETHA KARENGE].

dialogue.text: [CLAUSE 2: TARGETED BY DEMONS AND HUNTERS ALIKE]

panels.action: The screen flashes dark crimson: [CLAUSE 3: RELICS KI TAQAT TUMHARI PURANI YAADEIN CHEEN SAKTI HAI].
Ha-Jun flinches, clutching his chest: 'M-Meri yaadein...? Kya main bhaiya ko bhool jaunga...?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar main bhaiya ko hi bhool gaya... toh unhe bacha kar kya karunga?!

panels.action: Kuro: 'Sirf tab agar tum kamzor pad gaye. Agar tumhara irada lohe jaisa raha, toh tum Relics ko govern karoge.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agar tum taqatwar bane, toh koi yaad nahi mitegi.

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at the puddle reflection—no longer seeing a victim, but someone with a burning purpose.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kamzor rehne se behtar hai... aag mein kood jaana.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks with fearless conviction: 'Main tayar hoon.'
Ha-Jun slams his thumb firmly onto the glowing holographic [ACCEPT] button.
A crystal-clear dimensional resonance chime reverberates across the city: *PINGGGGG!!*
The interface UI shifts from cold obsidian into radiant royal purple and polished gold filigree.
An intricate demonic royal crest (two crossed black wings behind a violet crown) burns into the skin of Ha-Jun's right hand.
Kuro spreads his dark wings to their fullest span, screeching with ancient demonic ecstasy into the thunderstorm.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: ABYSS KE SULTAN KI PEHLI SEAL TOOT GAYI!!

panels.action: A cascade of violet notification windows pops into view: [REWARD 1: BLOODLINE REGENERATION RANK F UNLOCKED].
Next window: [REWARD 2: DEMONIC PERCEPTION RANK F UNLOCKED - MANA CURRENT SIGHT ENABLED].
Primary Quest pop-up: [MAIN QUEST: SURVIVE THE COMING SIEGE OF SAINT MIRREN].
Ha-Jun's vision shifts into infrared-violet: He can see the glowing mana pulses traveling through the campus electrical grid and ground.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Duniya... achanak aisi kyun dikh rahi hai?

panels.action: Through his new perception, Ha-Jun detects a warm human life signature climbing the staircase toward the rooftop access door.
Ha-Jun turns swiftly toward the heavy steel rooftop door: 'Koi upar aa raha hai...!'
Kuro: 'Mark chupao! Insaano ko Sovereign ka nishaan nahi dikhna chahiye!'
With a conscious mental command, the glowing crest fades seamlessly beneath Ha-Jun's pale skin, looking completely normal.
Kuro's physical form dissolves into a subtle crow silhouette inside Ha-Jun's elongated shadow on the wet ground.
The rusted industrial door pushes open with a loud metallic squeal against the rain.
Standing in the doorway is Min-Jae (17yo student, round glasses, bright yellow umbrella, dripping school uniform).

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun? Tum yahan kya kar rahe ho?

panels.action: Min-Jae steps out with his umbrella: 'Class khatam huye aadha ghanta ho gaya. Maine socha tum ghar chale gaye...'
Min-Jae suddenly freezes; his gaze drops to the severed steel railings and the massive scorched impact crater in the concrete.
Min-Jae's umbrella tilts, glasses reflecting the ruined rooftop: 'Kya... un bullies ne yeh sab kiya hai?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kya un ladko ne tumhe maarne ke liye dynamite use kiya?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun turns around with completely calm, flawless skin and a tranquil smile: 'Nahi Min-Jae... sirf aam toofan tha.' (Cliffhanger: In the wet puddle behind him, Ha-Jun's reflection casts colossal demonic wings).

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sirf aam toofan tha, Min-Jae. Chalo ghar chalte hain.
